mapper.select: select cxr.SIDEWALL_CODE, /*胎侧代码*/ IFNULL(sum(cxr.CLASS1_PLAN_QTY*cxr.SIDEWALL_LENGTH/1000),0) CX_CLASS1_PLAN_CONSUME /*成型今日早班计划*/ from ( SELECT r.EMBRYO_CODE, r.BOM_DATA_VERSION, max(ci.SIDEWALL_CODE) SIDEWALL_CODE, /*胎侧代码*/ max(ci.SIDEWALL_LENGTH) SIDEWALL_LENGTH, /*胎侧长*/ sum(IFNULL(r.CLASS3_PLANNED_QTY, 0) + IFNULL(r.CLASS2_PLAN_QTY, 0)) CLASS1_PLAN_QTY /*成型今日早班计划计划量*/ FROM T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT r inner join T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO ci on r.EMBRYO_CODE = ci.embryo_code and r.BOM_DATA_VERSION = ci.EMBRYO_VERSION and ci.DEL_FLAG = 0 /*施工信息表*/ where schedule_date = STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') and r.DEL_FLAG = 0 GROUP BY r.EMBRYO_CODE,r.BOM_DATA_VERSION ) cxr /*成型排程结果表*/ group by cxr.SIDEWALL_CODE

select MATERIAL_CODE sidewallCode, SUM(IFNULL(STOCK_NUM, 0) + IFNULL(MODIFY_NUM, 0) - IFNULL(BAD_NUM, 0)) STOCK_NUM from T_TC_STOCK where STOCK_DATE = DATE_ADD(#{stockDate}, INTERVAL -1 DAY) /*排程日期 要减1天，才是对应库存日期*/ and DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY MATERIAL_CODE
SELECT SIDEWALL_CODE, IFNULL(SUM(night_plan_qty), 0) consume FROM T_TC_SCHEDULE_RESULT WHERE SCHEDULE_DATE = DATE_ADD(#{scheduleDate}, INTERVAL -1 DAY) AND DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY SIDEWALL_CODE

SELECT t1.machine_id, t1.glue_code FROM T_TC_SCHEDULE_RESULT t1 JOIN ( -- 子查询找出每个 machine_id 对应的最大 night_produce_order SELECT schedule_date, machine_id, MAX(night_produce_order) as max_night_produce_order FROM T_TC_SCHEDULE_RESULT
WHERE DEL_FLAG = '0' AND schedule_date = DATE_ADD(#{scheduleDate}, INTERVAL -1 DAY) GROUP BY schedule_date, machine_id) t2 ON t1.schedule_date = t2.schedule_date AND t1.machine_id = t2.machine_id AND t1.night_produce_order = t2.max_night_produce_order WHERE t1.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND t1.schedule_date = DATE_ADD(#{scheduleDate}, INTERVAL -1 DAY) AND t1.machine_id IS NOT NULL AND t1.machine_id not like '%,%'
